# mani

Russian-language personal finance application at https://moimani.ai/

## Web application, updated 2026-11-06

- The web application is available for smartphone users at https://webapp.moimani.ai/
- The phone application is at https://webapp.moimani.ai/; desktop uses a QR handoff
- Primary actions open the web app; store notifications remain a separate optional form
- Available: Sber and T-Bank connections, account and transaction views, monthly summaries, upcoming payments, AI chat with photo and document attachments
- AI responds to user requests using available data, may make mistakes and cannot transfer money
- Bank/product coverage and saved history may be partial or stale; unknown values are not zero
- Website examples are illustrative, not analysis of the visitor's personal data
- Public store links are not supplied; the remaining waitlist is for store-release notifications
- Launch offer: first 1000 application users, 0 RUB/month forever; later new users from 549 RUB/month
- A waitlist position is not an application entitlement or an account
- Feedback is requested, not an invented mandatory quota or referral condition
